# slugs

A small internal library. Run the tests with:

    python -m pytest -q

Record every change under "Unreleased" in CHANGELOG.md.
files.slugs.py:
import re


def slugify(title):
    """Turns a title into a lower-case link part.

    Runs of non-alphanumeric characters collapse into one hyphen, and no
    hyphen is left at the start or end.
    """
    parts = re.split(r"[\W_]+", title.lower())
    return "-".join(p for p in parts if p)

import re


def slugify(title):
    """Turns a title into a lower-case link part.

    Runs of non-alphanumeric characters collapse into one hyphen, and no
    hyphen is left at the start or end.
    """
    parts = re.split(r"[\W_]+", title.lower())
    return "-".join(p for p in parts if p)
E
cat >> tests/test_slugs.py <<'E'


def test_punctuation_has_no_doubled_or_dangling_hyphen():
    assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"


def test_extra_spaces_and_hyphens_are_trimmed():
    assert slugify(" --Rock & Roll-- ") == "rock-roll"


def test_empty_and_symbol_only():
    assert slugify("") == ""
    assert slugify("!!!") == ""
E
